tools.name: find_hospital
tools.description: Look up UK hospitals by name, town or postcode. Returns each one's address, whether Findway has a map of its inside (and what it shows), its Findway page, and links to directions to the hospital in Apple Maps or Google Maps.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: List what a mapped UK hospital's map holds: its entrances, wards, departments and clinics, facilities (reception, pharmacy, food, toilets) and other places, each with where it is and a directions link. Optionally only one kind.
